summary: Build: `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true GX/Branched/Universality.lean` exits 0. The file has no sorry, admit or axiom. `taskset -c 0-11 lake build GX` reports 'Build completed successfully (8572 jobs)'. #print axioms, run from /tmp, gives [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for cex_branched_covering_composition, previous_examples_instances_developing_ruled, branchingLocus_orbitMk_cyl, previous_examples_foxCompletion, branched_covering_composition and maxBranched_isMaximal. Round-1 major FIXED: cex_branched_covering_composition now states, for EVERY y₀ ∉ S ∪ {apex}, branchingLocus p = insert apex S, q '' branchingLocus p = insert 0 (q '' S), and that this is ≠ q '' S. That proves the printed l.1186 equality false, and the finding is recorded in REPORT and SCOPE. The round-1 minors (∀ y₀; a flat decls list) are also fixed. Satisfiability checked by scratch instantiation. exists_isDenseFamilyY₀ feeds the cex. massive_particle (G = MinkIsom0, D = massiveDev 1 σ α) discharges hD and hΓ of previous_examples_instances_developing_ruled, so the hypotheses are not vacuous. rem:previous_examples under DEC-52 is certified in full. sing(M) ⊆ π{r=0}. D is a (G,X)-morphism on {r>0}. π{r=0} is skeletal and its complement is semilocally simply connected. The branching locus is EXACTLY π{r=0}, by a real argument: the connected apex basic set holds a and 1•a, which contradicts freeness on {r>0}. The cover is IsMaximalPossiblyBranched in every universe w, and for every base point it is an IsSpreadCompletion of the universal cover of π{r>0} (Fox) and homeomorphic over M to MaxBranchedCover. IsMaximalPossiblyBranched is non-trivial: it requires branched covering + possibly branched + domination by a branched covering of every competitor. The extra hypotheses are the paper's or are weaker. IsRigidAction is the paper's 'analytical' (l.341, README). X T2 and locally connected hold for X ⊆ ℝ^n. Any real normed V covers ℝ^{n-2}. α ≠ 0 is weaker than α > 0. The docstring marks are correct: cex and rem are marked under DEC-53/DEC-52, and prop:branched_covering_composition is unmarked and partial (DEC-48). All 7 labels of the module are in REPORT.json, and every listed decl exists in the file it is attributed to (contractibleSpace_cylPos is an instance in Quotient.lean). No declaration name of the file (128 checked) is declared elsewhere in GX/ or scaffold/. Only minor issues remain.

issues.problem: The ∃! is over the triple (maximal ∧ π an a.e. morphism ∧ sing ⊆ π{r=0}), inherited from quotientBase_ruled. That gives uniqueness only among atlases that also satisfy the singular-locus bound. It is weaker than the uniqueness among maximal atlases making π an a.e. morphism, which GX.quotientBase proves. The docstring wording states the stronger form. Uniqueness is not an assertion of rem:previous_examples itself (it belongs to ex:quotient_base / prop:aeGXquotient), so nothing the row claims is lost.
